post.description:
Stream one owned-draft upload through a private bounded staging file and answer 202 with its job.

The raw request body is the file's exact byte sequence, not a multipart part. `Content-Type` must be
given exactly once and match `kind`; `Content-Length` must be given exactly once and match the bytes
sent; `Transfer-Encoding` and any `Content-Encoding` other than `identity` are refused with 400, as is
any query parameter besides `strip_audio` and `upload_id`. Retry with the same `upload_id` to make a
repeated upload a no-op; a reused `upload_id` carrying different bytes answers 409. 400 once the source
exceeds the bound this router publishes in its `Squid-Max-Upload-Bytes` response header.

CreditedAliasDetail.description: One creator name held by this creator, and how many builds carry it.

DoorPatch.description:

IssuedCliSessionResponse.description: One-time CLI bearer token response from a verified device proof.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Disclosed once and never retrievable. Send it with the installation id in the `Squid-Installation-ID` and `Squid-Installation-Secret` headers.

IssuedInstallationResponse.title: IssuedInstallationResponse
IssuedInstallationResponse.description: Installation metadata and its one-time plaintext secret.

token.title: Token
token.description: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Returned once and never retrievable.

origin.description: Which client the grant was issued to: `paper` or `fabric`.

installation_id.title: Installation Id
installation_id.description: The Paper installation that vouched for the player. Always set when `origin` is `paper` and always null when it is `fabric`.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the token stops authenticating; open a new challenge to renew.

IssuedPlayerGrantResponse.title: IssuedPlayerGrantResponse
IssuedPlayerGrantResponse.description: One-time player bearer token response from a consumed challenge.

MediaKind.title: MediaKind
MediaKind.description: A hosted media type accepted by a submission.

MergeCodeDetail.title: MergeCodeDetail
MergeCodeDetail.description:
A freshly minted, single-use merge code.

The plaintext appears here and nowhere else: persistence keeps only a digest, so a lost code
is reminted rather than recovered.

absorbed_creator_id.title: Absorbed Creator Id
absorbed_creator_id.description: The creator id that would become a permanent redirect to the caller's.

MergePreviewDetail.title: MergePreviewDetail
MergePreviewDetail.description: What completing a merge would move, shown before the irreversible call.

MergeRequest.title: MergeRequest
MergeRequest.description: A merge code, redeemed by the account that will survive.

id.title: Id
id.description: Opaque projection key. Match it for equality; do not parse it.

metadata_kind.title: Metadata Kind
metadata_kind.description: What was matched: `creator`, `version`, or a tag's semantic kind (`restriction`, `pattern` or `showcase`).

MetadataSearchEntry.title: MetadataSearchEntry
MetadataSearchEntry.description: A matched taxonomy or version entry.

score.title: Score
score.description: Relevance, higher first. Comparable within one response only, never across queries; null when the results carry no ranking.

claimed_creator_name.title: Claimed Creator Name
claimed_creator_name.description: The creator credit now attributed to the caller under the current name.

retained_creator_names.title: Retained Creator Names
retained_creator_names.description: Credits kept under previously verified names. A rename does not retract them.

contested_creator_name.title: Contested Creator Name
contested_creator_name.description: Set when the current name is credited to a different account and was not taken.

pending_claim_id.title: Pending Claim Id
pending_claim_id.description: The staff review opened for a contested name.

MinecraftIdentityRefresh.title: MinecraftIdentityRefresh
MinecraftIdentityRefresh.description: What re-reading the linked Minecraft name changed.

NotificationPreferenceUpdate.title: NotificationPreferenceUpdate
NotificationPreferenceUpdate.description:
A complete pair of independently configurable notification channels.

Both switches are replaced, so an omitted one defaults to false and turns that channel off.

consent_pending.title: Consent Pending
consent_pending.description: True while the account still owes the current privacy notice, which refuses every attempt to enable a channel. The same fact reported by `UserMe`; there is no notification-specific notice.

web_enabled.title: Web Enabled
web_enabled.description: Whether new notifications reach the web inbox.

dm_enabled.title: Dm Enabled
dm_enabled.description: Whether new notifications are sent as Discord direct messages.

dm_suspended.title: Dm Suspended
dm_suspended.description: True after a direct message failed to deliver, which also turns `dm_enabled` off. Enabling DMs again clears it.

NotificationPreferencesDetail.title: NotificationPreferencesDetail
NotificationPreferencesDetail.description: Independent channel switches, and whether the account may use them yet.

subject_id.title: Subject Id
subject_id.description: A creator's `id` for `creator`, or a record's `competition_id` for `record`. The target must already exist.

NotificationSubscriptionCreate.title: NotificationSubscriptionCreate
NotificationSubscriptionCreate.description:
A creator, exact-record, or record-filter subscription request.

`subject_id` and `filter` are mutually exclusive: `creator` and `record` require the former,
`record_filter` requires the latter, and sending both or neither is rejected.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: The stored `RecordFilterInput` with every member sorted. Null unless `kind` is `record_filter`.

option_id.title: Option Id
option_id.description: The `id` of the option the caller chose.

OwnVoteSelection.title: OwnVoteSelection
OwnVoteSelection.description: The authenticated caller's own ballot selection.

PageAnchor.title: PageAnchor
PageAnchor.description: Query-parameter values addressing an adjacent page. Exactly one field is set.

java_uuid.title: Java Uuid
java_uuid.description: Java Edition UUID of the player being authorized.

PaperChallengeCreateRequest.title: PaperChallengeCreateRequest
PaperChallengeCreateRequest.description: Request player authorization from an authenticated Paper server.

device_code.title: Device Code
device_code.description: The `device_code` returned when the challenge was created, echoed verbatim.

PaperChallengeExchangeRequest.title: PaperChallengeExchangeRequest
PaperChallengeExchangeRequest.description: Exchange an approved Paper challenge on its authenticated installation.

PollScope.title: PollScope
PollScope.description: How far a generic poll is published.

version.title: Version
version.description: Identifier of the published notice, sent back when recording consent.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale the body was rendered in, echoed so a client can tell it received a fallback rather than what it asked for.

body.title: Body
body.description: Paragraphs separated by blank lines. Plain text, never markup: it is rendered into a Discord card, an HTML page and a terminal, and only one of those could parse anything else.

PrivacyNoticeDetail.title: PrivacyNoticeDetail
PrivacyNoticeDetail.description: The current notice, its version, and the locale it was rendered in.

ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail
ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem detail response with application extensions.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: Whether the public creator page is withheld. A hidden profile still serves its aliases and build credits, so builds stay attributable.

ProfileDetail.title: ProfileDetail
ProfileDetail.description: The caller's own profile, including anything it has chosen to hide.

ProfileLinkDetail.title: ProfileLinkDetail
ProfileLinkDetail.description: One external link published on a creator profile.

ProfileUpdateRequest.title: ProfileUpdateRequest
ProfileUpdateRequest.description:
A partial profile edit.

Omitting a field leaves it alone; sending null clears it. `hidden` is the exception: null there
sets the profile visible. `avatar_identity_id` takes an `id` from this account's `identities`.

submission.description: Submission form protocol versions this server serves; compare against a form manifest's `minimum_protocol` and `maximum_protocol`.

ProtocolCapabilities.title: ProtocolCapabilities
ProtocolCapabilities.description: Compatibility intervals for protocols outside HTTP API SemVer.

ProtocolInterval.title: ProtocolInterval
ProtocolInterval.description: Inclusive versions accepted for one independently versioned protocol.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The provider's own identifier: a Discord user snowflake, a lowercase hyphenated Minecraft UUID for `java`, or a decimal XUID for `bedrock`.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: The name the provider reports, null when it is unknown.

PublicIdentityDetail.title: PublicIdentityDetail
PublicIdentityDetail.description:
A linked identity the creator has chosen to publish.

Carries no verification timestamp and no internal id: when it was verified is nobody else's
business, and the id is the handle used to change it.

version_scope.title: Version Scope
version_scope.description: `all_time` for a record over every version, `current` for one scoped to the newest.

status.title: Status
status.description: `resolved` when the competition produced official holders, `unresolved` when the candidates left it undecided, `no_candidate` when nothing qualified.

holder_builds.title: Holder Builds
holder_builds.description: The builds named by `holder_build_ids`, in that order.

RecordDetail.title: RecordDetail
RecordDetail.description: One published record result with its ordered holder builds.

version_scopes.title: Version Scopes
version_scopes.description: `all_time` records span every version; `current` records are scoped to the newest one.

RecordFilterInput.title: RecordFilterInput
RecordFilterInput.description:
Broad structured predicates for record-gain subscriptions.

An empty set is a wildcard over that facet, but at least one of the four must be non-empty. A
record matches when it satisfies every non-empty facet and every tag predicate.

build_id.title: Build Id
build_id.description: The top-ranked holder build this entry is titled after.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Indexed measurements of the holder build, keyed by metric name. Which keys appear depends on the record, so read them by name.

RecordSearchEntry.title: RecordSearchEntry
RecordSearchEntry.description:
Projection facts for a matched computed record.

Every field here is derived by record computation rather than submitted by a user, so unlike
a build projection it carries no free text and can be served without hydration.

score.title: Score
score.description: Relevance, higher first. Comparable within one response only, never across queries; null when the results carry no ranking.

version_scope.title: Version Scope
version_scope.description: `all_time` for a record over every version, `current` for one scoped to the newest.

status.title: Status
status.description: `resolved` when the competition produced official holders, `unresolved` when the candidates left it undecided, `no_candidate` when nothing qualified.

RecordSummary.title: RecordSummary
RecordSummary.description:
One published computed record result.

A result belongs to the currently published computation run for its build kind and version, and a
newer run replaces it. `competition_id` names the competition across runs; it is what a record
notification subscription is keyed on.

controls.title: Controls
controls.description: Every `control` a form field may carry, so a client can refuse a manifest it cannot draw.

capability_identifiers.title: Capability Identifiers
capability_identifiers.description: Optional renderer behaviours a form field may require through `required_capability`.

RendererCapabilities.title: RendererCapabilities
RendererCapabilities.description: Form controls and optional renderer features emitted by the API.

SanitizationCapabilities.title: SanitizationCapabilities
SanitizationCapabilities.description:
Artifact transformations whose availability is compatibility-relevant.

Both values are fixed for this deployment: uploaded media is re-encoded before publication, and
no schematic sanitizer runs.

SchematicSize.title: SchematicSize
SchematicSize.description: A schematic bounding-box size, in blocks along each axis.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Whether this is the build's main schematic.

format.title: Format
format.description: Container format of the stored file: `litematic`, `schem`, `schematic`, `nbt` or `mcstructure`.

byte_size.title: Byte Size
byte_size.description: Size of the stored file in bytes.

dimensions.description: Tight bounding box of the placed blocks.

allocated_dimensions.description: Region the file allocates, which the tight box can be much smaller than.

block_count.title: Block Count
block_count.description: Non-air blocks. Not the Door Rules cumulative volume, which counts air pockets and carries hallway, frame and hitbox exceptions.

palette_size.title: Palette Size
palette_size.description: Distinct block states in the file's palette.

source_data_version.title: Source Data Version
source_data_version.description: Minecraft data version the file declares, null when its format records none.

analyzer_version.title: Analyzer Version
analyzer_version.description: Which analysis pass produced these metrics. Values from different versions are not comparable.

license.title: License
license.description: Creative Commons license the submitter granted, such as `cc_by_4_0`.

download_url.title: Download Url
download_url.description: Path on this API serving the file; relative to the API root, not absolute.

SchematicSummary.title: SchematicSummary
SchematicSummary.description:
Allowlisted analysis metadata for one stored build schematic.

Only schematics the submitter published for download appear here, so every one carries a license.

name.title: Name
name.description: Canonical name to use in a query.

supports_range.title: Supports Range
supports_range.description: Whether the field accepts range comparisons rather than equality only.

supports_sort.title: Supports Sort
supports_sort.description: Whether results may be ordered by this field.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other names accepted for `name`, matched case-insensitively.

SearchField.title: SearchField
SearchField.description: One query field supported by the public search grammar.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Indexed terms close to the query's positive text, at most the requested limit.

SearchSuggestions.title: SearchSuggestions
SearchSuggestions.description: Indexed terms completing a partial query.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this installation appears in the public server list.

sponsor_opt_in.title: Sponsor Opt In
sponsor_opt_in.description: Whether builds submitted through this installation carry it as their sponsor. The attribution is captured at finalization and does not change afterwards.

ServerProfileSchema.title: ServerProfileSchema
ServerProfileSchema.description:
Explicit public listing and sponsor preferences for a Paper server.

Every text field is trimmed before storage; nothing here is published until `enabled` is true.

schema_revision.title: Schema Revision
schema_revision.description: Form revision this draft is pinned to.

category.title: Category
category.description: Lowercase snake_case identifier of at most 64 characters, stable across form revisions.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Rises by one per applied change; send it as the next change's `base_revision`.

status.description: `editing` accepts changes; `processing` is being finalized; `needs_attention` has repairable issues; `submitted` produced a build; `expired` passed `expires_at`.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Current answers by field id. An unanswered field is absent.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the draft is discarded if it is not finalized first.

source_installation_id.title: Source Installation Id
source_installation_id.description: The Paper installation the draft came from. Null for every other origin.

StoredDraftResponse.title: StoredDraftResponse
StoredDraftResponse.description: The compacted current state of one caller-owned synchronized draft.

reason.description: What is wrong with it, as a stable code to branch on.

SubmissionAttentionIssueResponse.title: SubmissionAttentionIssueResponse
SubmissionAttentionIssueResponse.description: One stable field-level reason that a submitter can act on.

SubmissionAttentionReason.title: SubmissionAttentionReason
SubmissionAttentionReason.description: Stable repair reasons shared by every submission transport.

draft_revision.title: Draft Revision
draft_revision.description: The draft revision this job was started from.

status.description: `pending` and `claimed` are still running; `needs_attention` lists repairable `issues`; `completed` carries `build_id`; `dead` failed for good.

build_id.title: Build Id
build_id.description: The build finalization produced. Null until `status` is `completed`.

SubmissionFinalizationResponse.title: SubmissionFinalizationResponse
SubmissionFinalizationResponse.description: Owner-visible state of durable draft finalization.

SubmissionOrigin.title: SubmissionOrigin
SubmissionOrigin.description: A transport that can own or finalize a submission draft.

description.title: Description
description.description: Secondary text disambiguating candidates that share a label; null when there is none.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The entity type behind the candidate, for keeping a mixed list readable.

SuggestionItem.title: SuggestionItem
SuggestionItem.description:
One candidate completion.

`value` is what a client submits and `label` is what it shows. They differ wherever a command
or form field stores an identifier the user should never have to see.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source these completions came from.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Content revision of an enumerable source, matching the response `ETag`. Null for a queried source, which has no enumerable content to revision.

replacement.description: Present when a value completes part of the query; null when it replaces all of it.

SuggestionPage.title: SuggestionPage
SuggestionPage.description: Ranked completions for one partially typed value.

start.title: Start
start.description: Character offset of the first replaced character.

end.title: End
end.description: Character offset just past the last replaced character.

SuggestionReplacement.title: SuggestionReplacement
SuggestionReplacement.description:
The half-open range of the submitted query a value replaces.

Splice the chosen `value` over it rather than clobbering the whole input.

kind.description: `enumerable` sources can be listed and cached whole; `queried` ones must be asked per query.

context_keys.title: Context Keys
context_keys.description: Context this source needs supplied, such as `category`, sorted ascending.

multi_value.title: Multi Value
multi_value.description: Separator when the completed parameter holds a list, so a client splices one entry. Null for a single-valued parameter.

requires_authentication.title: Requires Authentication
requires_authentication.description: True when the source is gated or scoped, so an anonymous caller gets nothing.

SuggestionSourceInfo.title: SuggestionSourceInfo
SuggestionSourceInfo.description: What a client needs to know to drive one source without hardcoding it.

key.title: Key
key.description: Stable identifier, safe to hardcode; `name` is not.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name, which staff may change.

query_name.title: Query Name
query_name.description: Lowercase snake_case name accepted in search queries. Null when the tag is not queryable.

authority.title: Authority
authority.description: `official` for a staff-defined tag, `user` for a member-defined one. Only official tags are restrictions or patterns.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the tag asserts: `restriction` for a rule the build obeys, `pattern` for one it uses, `showcase` for a free-form label.

value_type.title: Value Type
value_type.description: Type an assignment carries: `none`, `numeric`, `text` or `boolean`. A `none` tag is a bare label.

restriction_type.title: Restriction Type
restriction_type.description: Set exactly when `kind` is `restriction`, and null otherwise.

record_operator.title: Record Operator
record_operator.description: How an assignment satisfies a record predicate: `present`, `exact`, `at_most` or `at_least`. Always null when `kind` is `showcase`.

canonical_unit.title: Canonical Unit
canonical_unit.description: Unit assigned values are stored in.

display_unit.title: Display Unit
display_unit.description: Unit to present values in by default, which may differ from storage.

TagDetail.title: TagDetail
TagDetail.description:
A published tag clients may use in build and search views.

Only approved tags are published, and the unit and step fields are set on numeric tags alone.

tag_id.title: Tag Id
tag_id.description: Id of a tag published by `/v1/tags`.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: `present` matches any assignment of the tag; `exact` additionally requires `value` to equal the assigned value.

value.title: Value
value.description: Required when `operator` is `exact`, and rejected when it is `present`.

TagPredicateInput.title: TagPredicateInput
TagPredicateInput.description: A required tag presence or exact typed value.

max_source_bytes.title: Max Source Bytes
max_source_bytes.description: Total uploaded bytes across a draft, not one file.

max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes
max_output_bytes.description: Total normalized bytes across a draft, not one file.

max_pixels_per_frame.title: Max Pixels Per Frame
max_pixels_per_frame.description: Width times height of one decoded frame, per file.

max_decoded_pixels_per_second.title: Max Decoded Pixels Per Second
max_decoded_pixels_per_second.description: Pixels per frame times frame rate, per video file. Images are exempt.

UploadCapabilities.title: UploadCapabilities
UploadCapabilities.description:
Upload, aggregate, and decoder-work limits enforced by the backend.

Exceeding any of them is rejected server-side; a client that checks first spares the upload.

User.title: User
User.description: Verification request body: the player's Java (Minecraft) account UUID.

creator_id.title: Creator Id
creator_id.description: The public identifier this account's creator page is served under.

consent_version.title: Consent Version
consent_version.description: Version of the privacy notice this account last consented to; null if it never has.

consent_pending.title: Consent Pending
consent_pending.description: Whether the account still owes the current privacy notice. While true every write fails with 400 until `/v1/users/me/consent` is posted.

UserMe.title: UserMe
UserMe.description:
The caller's own account: who they are, how they sign in, and what they publish.

Provider-neutral: every linked identity is an entry in `identities`, however many an account
holds from one provider, and an account may hold none.

ValueKind.title: ValueKind
ValueKind.description: Canonical JSON value expected from a field.

ValueType.title: ValueType
ValueType.description: The scalar type a suggestion's value carries.

patch.title: Patch
patch.description: Zero for a release written without one, such as `1.20`.

VisibilityOperator.title: VisibilityOperator
VisibilityOperator.description: Operators supported by the deliberately narrow visibility language.

field_id.title: Field Id
field_id.description: The field whose answer is tested.

operator.description: `equals` and `not_equals` compare the answer to `value`; `in` tests membership and requires `value` to be an array.

VisibilityRuleResponse.title: VisibilityRuleResponse
VisibilityRuleResponse.description:
A condition controlling whether a field is shown, evaluated by any client.

A field whose rule does not match is hidden and not validated, so leaving it unanswered is fine.

VoteInput.title: VoteInput
VoteInput.description: A stable option selection in one Discord guild.

VoteKind.title: VoteKind
VoteKind.description: What a vote session decides, and therefore how it closes.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable option identifier, and the key used in `tallies` and `own_selection`.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display text. Always set on a generic poll's options; null on the fixed approve and deny ones, which a client labels itself.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: `approve` and `deny` sign the option's weight in the net score; `generic` options do not score.

VoteOptionSummary.title: VoteOptionSummary
VoteOptionSummary.description: A stable vote option without Discord-specific reaction aliases.

visibility.description: How much is disclosed while the poll is open: `anonymous_live` and `visible_live` publish tallies, `anonymous_hidden` withholds them until it closes.

scope.description: `guild` accepts ballots from one server, `network` from every server the bot serves.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: When the poll closes itself; a generic poll never closes on a score.

kind.description: `build` and `delete_log` close themselves once `net` reaches a threshold; `generic` closes on its deadline.

result.description: `pending` until the session closes; then `approved`, `denied` or `cancelled`.

pass_threshold.title: Pass Threshold
pass_threshold.description: Positive net score that approves the session. Set on threshold kinds and null on a generic poll.

fail_threshold.title: Fail Threshold
fail_threshold.description: Negative net score that denies the session. Set on threshold kinds and null on a generic poll.

build_id.title: Build Id
build_id.description: Null unless the session targets a build.

tallies.description: Null while an `anonymous_hidden` poll is open; present once it closes.

own_selection.description: The authenticated caller's own ballot; null when they have not voted.

VoteSessionDetail.title: VoteSessionDetail
VoteSessionDetail.description: A vote session with aggregate-only ballot data.

VoteSessionResult.title: VoteSessionResult
VoteSessionResult.description: The decision a closed session reached.

VoteStatus.title: VoteStatus
VoteStatus.description: Whether a session still accepts ballots.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: How many ballots chose each option, by option id.

weighted.title: Weighted
weighted.description: Summed ballot weights per option id.

downvotes.title: Downvotes
downvotes.description: Total weight cast against, as a positive number.

net.title: Net
net.description: `upvotes` minus `downvotes`, the score a threshold vote closes on.

VoteTallies.title: VoteTallies
VoteTallies.description: Aggregate results which cannot identify individual voters.

VoteVisibility.title: VoteVisibility
VoteVisibility.description: How much of a generic poll's state is disclosed while it is open.

RequestId.description: Correlation id for this request; an echo of a valid inbound Request-Id when supplied.
